description: Forecast (not yet confirmed) transactions: the overdue ones (date already passed, waiting to be confirmed against the bank) and the ones due in the next `days` days (bills, salaries, renewals). Each row has the id that confirm_forecast accepts.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

overdue_days.description: How far back to look for overdue unconfirmed forecasts (default 60).

name: list_upcoming
title: Upcoming and overdue forecast transactions
